## Checklist

- [ ] Coverage ≥ 80 % for the changed module
- [ ] No secrets / credentials in diff
- [ ] Dependencies added are compatible with proprietary licensing (no GPL / AGPL)
- [ ] Threat model entry updated if attack surface changes
- [ ] Docs / README updated if user-visible behaviour changes
- [ ] `/security-review` run clean
- [ ] `/code-review` (or `/code-review-excellence`) run clean
